blocks.en: Protect engineered crops from climate stress using targeted biological protectants, without releasing live bacteria.
blocks.text: Protect engineered crops from climate stress using targeted biological protectants, without releasing live bacteria.
blocks.zh: 以專一的生物保護劑保護工程改造的作物抵禦氣候逆境，而且不把活菌釋放到環境中。

blocks.en:
6-chapter field trial.
Protect real crops.
Validate the PGPR system.
blocks.text: 6-chapter field trial.Protect real crops.Validate the PGPR system.
blocks.zh:
六章的田間試驗。
保護真實的作物。
驗證 PGPR 系統。

blocks.en:
Endless escalation.
High score challenge.
Unlocks after campaign.
blocks.text: Endless escalation.High score challenge.Unlocks after campaign.
blocks.zh:
難度無止盡上升。
挑戰高分。
完成劇情後解鎖。

blocks.en: 💻 PC / LAPTOP MODE ACTIVE ▾ Tap to Change
blocks.text: 💻 PC / LAPTOP MODE ACTIVE ▾ Tap to Change
blocks.zh: 💻 電腦 / 筆電模式已啟用 ▾ 點選更改
第 1 章 / 共 6 章

blocks.en: Defeat all stresses to complete the chapter.
blocks.text: Defeat all stresses to complete the chapter.
blocks.zh: 擊退所有逆境即可完成本章。

blocks.text: Move: Arrow buttons (mobile) or ← → / A D (keyboard)
blocks.zh: 移動：方向鍵按鈕（手機）或 ← → / A D（鍵盤）

blocks.en: Dash: Gold button (mobile) or Shift / Z: quick burst dodge
blocks.text: Dash: Gold button (mobile) or Shift / Z: quick burst dodge
blocks.zh: 衝刺：金色按鈕（手機）或 Shift / Z：瞬間爆發閃避

blocks.en: Pulse: E key or ⚡ button: area blast, slows & damages all enemies
blocks.text: Pulse: E key or ⚡ button: area blast, slows & damages all enemies
blocks.zh: 脈衝：E 鍵或 ⚡ 按鈕：範圍衝擊，減速並傷害所有敵人

blocks.en: Switch protectant: Tap the colored buttons at the bottom (or keys 1 to 4)
blocks.text: Switch protectant: Tap the colored buttons at the bottom (or keys 1 to 4)
blocks.zh: 切換保護劑：點選下方的彩色按鈕（或按 1 到 4）

blocks.en: Heat Protectant: Effective against Heat Stress ☀. LEA peptides stabilize proteins denatured by extreme temperatures.
blocks.text: Heat Protectant: Effective against Heat Stress ☀. LEA peptides stabilize proteins denatured by extreme temperatures.
blocks.zh: 耐熱保護劑：對熱逆境 ☀有效。LEA 胜肽能穩定被極端高溫破壞結構的蛋白質。

blocks.en: Saline Protectant: Effective against Salinity Stress ⬡. Triggers osmotic adjustment genes to counter salt-induced water loss.
blocks.text: Saline Protectant: Effective against Salinity Stress ⬡. Triggers osmotic adjustment genes to counter salt-induced water loss.
blocks.zh: 抗鹽保護劑：對鹽逆境 ⬡有效。啟動滲透調節基因，對抗鹽分造成的水分流失。

blocks.en: Antifungal: Effective against Fungal Stress 🍄. NaD1 defensin peptides disrupt fungal cell membranes.
blocks.text: Antifungal: Effective against Fungal Stress 🍄. NaD1 defensin peptides disrupt fungal cell membranes.
blocks.zh: 抗真菌劑：對真菌逆境 🍄有效。NaD1 防禦素胜肽會破壞真菌的細胞膜。

blocks.en: Anti-Insect: Effective against Aphids and Caterpillars. Bt toxins target insect gut receptors.
blocks.text: Anti-Insect: Effective against Aphids and Caterpillars. Bt toxins target insect gut receptors.
blocks.zh: 抗蟲劑：對蚜蟲和毛毛蟲有效。Bt 毒蛋白作用於昆蟲腸道的受體。

blocks.en: Heat: Falls straight down. Fast. Use Heat Protectant.
blocks.text: Heat: Falls straight down. Fast. Use Heat Protectant.
blocks.zh: 高溫：直線落下，速度快。用耐熱保護劑。

blocks.en: Salinity: Zigzags side to side. Use Saline Protectant.
blocks.text: Salinity: Zigzags side to side. Use Saline Protectant.
blocks.zh: 鹽分：左右來回蛇行。用抗鹽保護劑。

blocks.text: Fungal: Spirals slowly. Tanky. Use Antifungal.
blocks.zh: 真菌：緩慢螺旋前進，很耐打。用抗真菌劑。

blocks.text: Aphids: Fast swarm movement. Use Anti-Insect.
blocks.zh: 蚜蟲：成群快速移動。用抗蟲劑。

blocks.en: Caterpillar: Very slow but extremely tough. Use Anti-Insect.
blocks.text: Caterpillar: Very slow but extremely tough. Use Anti-Insect.
blocks.zh: 毛毛蟲：非常慢，但極為耐打。用抗蟲劑。

blocks.en: Using the correct protectant deals 7× more damage. Wrong protectants barely scratch enemies.
blocks.text: Using the correct protectant deals 7× more damage. Wrong protectants barely scratch enemies.
blocks.zh: 用正確的保護劑造成的傷害是 7 倍。用錯的幾乎傷不到敵人。

blocks.en: Your shield absorbs hits. Watch for cracks. Once broken, one more hit ends the game.
blocks.text: Your shield absorbs hits. Watch for cracks. Once broken, one more hit ends the game.
blocks.zh: 你的護盾會吸收攻擊。注意上面的裂痕；一旦破裂，再被打中一次遊戲就結束。

blocks.en: The crop's health drops each time a stress reaches the bottom. Keep it above 50% for a better harvest grade.
blocks.text: The crop's health drops each time a stress reaches the bottom. Keep it above 50% for a better harvest grade.
blocks.zh: 每當有一個逆境落到底部，作物的健康值就會下降。維持在 50% 以上才能拿到更好的收成評級。

blocks.en: Save the Pulse for when multiple enemies are about to reach the crop: it slows and damages all of them at once.
blocks.text: Save the Pulse for when multiple enemies are about to reach the crop: it slows and damages all of them at once.
blocks.zh: 把脈衝留到多個敵人快要碰到作物時再用：它會一次減速並傷害全部敵人。

blocks.en: Spend credits in the Upgrade Lab between chapters to improve fire rate, shield HP, dash cooldown, and more.
blocks.text: Spend credits in the Upgrade Lab between chapters to improve fire rate, shield HP, dash cooldown, and more.
blocks.zh: 在章節之間到升級實驗室花點數，可以提升射速、護盾耐久、衝刺冷卻時間等等。

blocks.en: This game simulates a sealed PGPR bioreactor that senses stress signals and releases targeted protectants, without releasing live bacteria into the environment.
blocks.text: This game simulates a sealed PGPR bioreactor that senses stress signals and releases targeted protectants, without releasing live bacteria into the environment.
blocks.zh: 這款遊戲模擬一個密閉的 PGPR 生物反應器：它偵測逆境訊號，釋出專一的保護劑，而不會把活菌釋放到環境中。

blocks.en: The goal is to validate that engineered biological systems can protect crops from climate change stress more precisely than traditional pesticides.
blocks.text: The goal is to validate that engineered biological systems can protect crops from climate change stress more precisely than traditional pesticides.
blocks.zh: 目標是驗證工程改造的生物系統能比傳統農藥更精準地保護作物，抵禦氣候變遷帶來的逆境。

blocks.en:
The PGPR bioreactor system has been validated across all six field trials.
Crops protected without releasing any live bacteria into the environment.
blocks.text: The PGPR bioreactor system has been validated across all six field trials. Crops protected without releasing any live bacteria into the environment.
blocks.zh:
PGPR 生物反應器系統已在全部六場田間試驗中通過驗證。
作物受到保護，而且沒有任何活菌被釋放到環境中。
